integrity: The infinite claim is supported by a row/column coefficient proof. Exact finite enumeration through five columns is corroboration only. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for rational semigroup Schur rings on labeled two-row rectangular bands; no claim for three or more rows, other fields, or counting modulo automorphisms. Historical priority cannot be independently certified.
title: All Schur rings of two-row rectangular bands: automorphic rigidity and an exact enumerator
